sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "license_plate" TEXT NULL, "image_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "compartments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "vehicle_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "grid_row" INTEGER NULL, "grid_col" INTEGER NULL, "grid_col_span" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "seite" TEXT NULL, "laengsposition" TEXT NULL, "image_path" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "equipment_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "short_name" TEXT NULL, "equipment_functions_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "deployment_scenarios_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "image_path" TEXT NULL, "training_url" TEXT NULL, "library_equipment_id" TEXT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "extra_attributes_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "training_questions_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "typical_use_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "remote_type_id" TEXT NULL, "remote_type_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "type_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("type_dirty" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "equipment_assignments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "compartment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES compartments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "equipment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quiz_results" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "quiz_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "score" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vehicle_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "played_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "equipment_instances" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "equipment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "vehicle_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "compartment_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES compartments (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "identifier" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspection_schedules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "instance_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_instances (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_months" INTEGER NULL, "last_done_at" INTEGER NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspection_log" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "schedule_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES inspection_schedules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "done_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "done_by" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_aliases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "equipment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_meta" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_pulled_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_pulled_at" INTEGER NULL, "local_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("local_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "last_type_cursor" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learning_progress" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "equipment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "correct_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "wrong_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_practiced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("equipment_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "vehicle_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "done_by" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_checks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "equipment_id" INTEGER NULL, "compartment_id" INTEGER NULL, "equipment_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "compartment_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "actual_quantity" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicle_attachments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "vehicle_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'document', "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "storage_path" TEXT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
